data.body: Coordination from epic nonblack-brigandish-guillemot (op-cert trust, cluster T1): T1 changes op-cert verification only. It will not edit `src/rebar/_commands/verify_authorship.py`, `src/rebar/schemas/verify_identity_report.schema.json`, `src/rebar/_commands/reclaim_dry_run.py`, or the identity tests/docs in this ticket's file impact. T1's `verify-opcert` rework keeps importing `_collect_all`, `_is_enforced` and `_resolve_commit` from verify_authorship.py unchanged; please keep those three names and signatures stable, or comment here if they must change. T1 adds a `signing_key` field (SHA256 fingerprint, as `fsck_authorship.signer_key_id` prints it) to op-cert verify results in `verify_signature_result.schema.json`, matching the name this ticket uses for verify-identity.
